message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) for the described facts.

Facts: Zhang (defendant) accepted contracts for temporary facility wall projects from a real estate developer. He colluded with project managers (Liu and Huang) to give them kickbacks (bribes) from the project price. He gave them money (22800 and 71392). This is bribery (行贿) but note that the bribe is given by a private individual (contractor) to public officials? Actually Liu and Huang are project comprehensive department deputy general manager and project engineering (supervision) deputy manager of a private company (Fuding Biyu Garden Real Estate Development Co., Ltd). They are not public officials; they are corporate employees. So the crime is "行贿" (bribery) but specifically "向非国家工作人员行贿" (bribery of non-state personnel). The correct label in examples: For a case where a private person gives bribe to a corporate employee, they used "行贿". In the example: 黄某某 case gave 3万元 to 于某甲 (who is a railway company employee) and answer was "行贿". So we can use "行贿". Also possibly "受贿" for the recipients, but we only charge the defendant. So "行贿". Also maybe "非法经营" or "商业贿赂"? The crime of giving bribes to corporate staff is "行贿罪" (bribery). So answer: [罪名]行贿<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes: The act of colluding to get contracts via false means? He used "挂靠" (hired under another company) but not necessarily illegal. The main crime is bribery. So single charge.
